_meta.note: Google Antigravity ACP 1.5.0 with a nonexistent stdio MCP command (nonexistent_mcp_cmd_99999_probe). session/new returns a valid session with no MCP init failure notification because stdio MCP mounts lazily on session/prompt; session/prompt emits an agent_message_chunk naming the failed MCP server and ends with stopReason end_turn. Sanitized with synthetic session id, one public model, and available_commands_update omitted.
